前置条件：categraf 的 jenkins.toml 必须显式配置 max_: Prerequisite: categraf's jenkins.toml must set max_build_age explicitly. Left unset it defaults to 0, which makes every completed build be treated as expired so job-level metrics are never collected. result_code values are 0=Success, 1=Failure, 2=Not_built, 3=Unstable, 4=Aborted.
